00ccfb3b6630.name: Sonic Lance Note
00ccfb3b6630.plain: Note: after many requests, the sonic lance is provided to support older models that GW appears to have forgotten. Its data and points come from where it last appeared, the 8th edition (8e) FW xenos index. It is no longer current or official, so get your opponent's agreement before you use it.

01fa85516e28.name: Deathshroud Cannon (Dispersed)
01fa85516e28.plain: Blast. Attacks made with this profile hit the target automatically, and an unmodified wound roll of 5+ gives that attack an Armour Penetration characteristic of -4.

02190f2c2bd0.name: Wailing Doom (Sweeping Blow)
02190f2c2bd0.plain: For every attack made with this profile, you make 2 hit rolls rather than 1.

02710374d03c.name: Fury of the Tempest
02710374d03c.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon wounds the target automatically.

028fd59df756.name: Gloom Field
028fd59df756.plain: When a model more than 18" away shoots at the bearer's unit, that unit gets the benefits of Dense Cover against the attack.

02af2bb7842a.name: Resonator Shard
02af2bb7842a.plain: During your Shooting phase, as one of your units with any models carrying a D-cannon, doomweaver or shadow weaver is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, a model of that unit carrying one of those weapons may re-roll the hit roll for any attack it makes against an enemy unit that is within 12" of any friendly RESONATOR SHARD units.

036fc67e7384.name: Swooping Hawk Wings
036fc67e7384.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 14", and it gains the JUMP PACK and FLY keywords plus the Winged Descent ability.

094b34beadef.name: Assured Destruction
094b34beadef.plain: Whenever a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, you re-roll a wound roll of 1.

095dc3be3c9b.name: Crushing Blows
095dc3be3c9b.plain: When this unit's Striking Scorpion Exarch model makes a melee attack against a non-TITANIC unit and scores a hit, that attack wounds the target automatically.

09db87b26b39.name: Psychic Powers (Warlocks)
09db87b26b39.plain: If this unit's Starting Strength is 4 or more, it knows 1 extra power from the Runes of Battle discipline. While it has 4 or more models, it can try to manifest 1 extra psychic power in your Psychic phase.

0a3bd997ed9c.name: Prince of Corsairs
0a3bd997ed9c.plain: Before the battle, when you put units into Strategic Reserves, if this model is in your army you can count IYANDEN INFANTRY units and ANHRATHE units at half their Power Rating when working out the total Power Rating of everything you are placing in Strategic Reserves.

0a6bac8611b8.name: Speed of Vaul
0a6bac8611b8.plain: When this model Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, add 12" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

0bcbcc565da7.name: Inescapable Accuracy
0bcbcc565da7.plain: Targets of ranged attacks made by models in this unit don't get the benefits of Dense Cover against those attacks.

0c082a336059.name: Nerve-shredding Shriek
0c082a336059.plain: Every time this unit finishes a charge move, you may roll one D6 for an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of this unit's Howling Banshee Exarch. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal wound on that enemy unit; also, for the rest of the turn, Combat Attrition tests taken for it have 1 subtracted from them.

0cb873227a22.name: Reaper's Reach
0cb873227a22.plain: While this unit includes a Dark Reaper Exarch, its models don't take the hit roll penalty for shooting Heavy weapons in a turn their unit moved.

0cf99669329f.name: Runesuit
0cf99669329f.plain: This model gets a 4+ invulnerable save. When an attack is made against it, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails, no matter what abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

0eb7edeffdad.name: Webway Shunt Generator
0eb7edeffdad.plain: In your Movement phase, when this model is picked to move and isn't in Engagement Range of any enemy units, you can send it back to the webway by removing it from the battlefield. Later, during the Reinforcements step of any of your Movement phases, it can arrive: place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model. If it hasn't arrived by the end of the battle, it is destroyed.

0ff7902e8852.name: 2. Storm of Whispers
0ff7902e8852.plain: If this power is manifested, roll three D6 for every enemy unit within 9" of this PSYKER. Each of those enemy units suffers 1 mortal wound for every 4+ rolled for it.

102c9872f77c.name: Spectre Holo-Field
102c9872f77c.plain: Attacks made against this model have 1 subtracted from their hit roll.

1203429d6aee.name: Kha-vir, the Sword of Sorrows.
1203429d6aee.plain: For attacks with this weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 inflicts 2 mortal wounds on the target and ends the attack sequence.

138448c6b11e.name: 1.2 Reveal (Malediction)
138448c6b11e.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, that enemy unit gets no benefit from cover against attacks made by ASURYANI models in your army.

13cd3d21023c.name: Titanic Ghostglaive - Sweep
13cd3d21023c.plain: For each attack made with this profile, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1.

141086d9b6fc.name: Eyes of Khaine
141086d9b6fc.plain: Attacks this model makes against an enemy unit that can FLY hit the target automatically.

142167372dbf.name: Skyleap
142167372dbf.plain: In your Shooting phase, rather than making a Battle Focus move with this unit, you can take it off the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

14e83bb4e008.name: 3.1 Enhance (Blessing)
14e83bb4e008.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 1 to the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

150e837f2593.name: Wrath of the Dead
150e837f2593.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, choose a WRAITH HOST WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit of yours. For the rest of that phase, its models' Attacks characteristic goes up by 1.

1593a99e64b4.name: Relics of the Shrines
1593a99e64b4.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ASURYANI keyword: pick 2 models in your army with the word 'Exarch' in their profile. Each of them can be given one Aspect Shrine Relic, which must be one it could have. Every Relic in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't be used to give a model 2 Relics. You can use it only once, but twice in a Strike Force battle or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

1605b661a9dc.name: Ancient Doom
1605b661a9dc.plain: In a turn in which Amallyn Shadowguide charges, or is charged by, a Slaanesh unit, you can re-roll her failed hit rolls in the Fight phase. However, while she is within 3" of any Slaanesh units, you must add 1 to her Morale tests.

166a42e549f8.name: Psyker
166a42e549f8.plain: In your Psychic phase this model can try to manifest two psychic powers, and in your opponent's Psychic phase it can try to deny two. It knows Smite and every psychic power in the Revenant discipline.

17f96eaaeb26.name: Flickerjump
17f96eaaeb26.plain: The first time in each phase that an enemy charge targets this unit, it may make a Normal Move of up to 6", as long as it isn't in Engagement Range of any enemy units. For the rest of that phase it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. After that, your opponent may pick new charge targets if they want.

187285e23513.name: Multifaceted Mind
187285e23513.plain: In your Psychic phase, after a FARSEER, SHADOWSEER or YVRAINE model from your army attempts a psychic action: that unit can try to manifest one psychic power this phase.

18f0929c6f6a.name: Defence Tactics
18f0929c6f6a.plain: While this unit includes a Dire Avenger Exarch model and is performing an action, it can still shoot with ranged weapons without that action failing.

196fa9f3b0c9.name: Distortion Field
196fa9f3b0c9.plain: Against ranged attacks, this model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

1a716effc89d.name: Outcasts and Pirates
1a716effc89d.plain: If your army is Battle-Forged, this unit can't fill a compulsory slot in a Detachment (for example, being one of the three Elites units a Vanguard Detachment must have) unless every unit in that Detachment is an ANHRATHE unit.

1b5047c7843b.name: Cloudstrider
1b5047c7843b.plain: Once per turn, instead of Consolidating or making a Battle Focus move with this model, you can take it off the battlefield and place it again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from every enemy model.

1ba59fcb4f92.name: Shroud Runner Cloak
1ba59fcb4f92.plain: This unit's models can receive Light Cover benefits as though they were INFANTRY models. If one of its models has a ranged attack allocated to it while it is receiving cover benefits, its armour saving throw against that attack gets a further 1 added.

1eb5d1bddd6e.name: The Curtain Falls
1eb5d1bddd6e.plain: During the Fight phase, once one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units has made all its attacks but before it consolidates: rather than consolidating normally, if all its models are within 6" of a friendly <SAEDATH> TRANSPORT model, it may embark within that TRANSPORT model as though it were your Movement phase, even if it disembarked this turn, provided the TRANSPORT model has enough free transport capacity for the whole unit.

1f77d53bd5f7.name: Diresword
1f77d53bd5f7.plain: Whenever this weapon successfully wounds with an attack, the attack sequence ends and the target takes 1 mortal wound.

20354583f8a1.name: Feigned Retreat
20354583f8a1.plain: During your Movement phase, as one of your ASURYANI, HARLEQUINS or YNNARI units Falls Back: you may make it eligible to shoot this turn, eligible to declare a charge this turn, or both. Choosing both makes this Stratagem cost 2CP; otherwise its cost is 1CP.

20744ce4969e.name: Seer Council
20744ce4969e.plain: If your army is Battle-forged: for every FARSEER model in a Detachment, you can add one WARLOCKS unit to that Detachment, and that unit doesn't use up a Battlefield Role slot.

213f70c6f660.name: Shadow Hunter (Aura)
213f70c6f660.plain: Aura: while one of your STRIKING SCORPIONS units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

216bfa3bc200.name: Suppressing Fire
216bfa3bc200.plain: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, you can pick one enemy unit that this unit's Swooping Hawks Exarch targeted with a ranged attack this phase and roll 3D6. If the total beats that enemy unit's Leadership, then until the start of your next Shooting phase it can't fire Overwatch, Set to Defend or perform any actions (any action it was performing fails immediately).

22dbbe7afed8.name: Mistshield
22dbbe7afed8.plain: The bearer gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

236a8e5accfe.name: Warp Spider Jump Generator
236a8e5accfe.plain: During any Normal Move, Battle Focus move, Advance, Fall Back or charge move the bearer's unit makes, its models may pass horizontally through models and terrain features, though no move can end on top of another unit or its base. For a Battle Focus move by the bearer's unit, you may roll 2D6 instead of one D6 to find how far its models can go; if you choose to and roll a double 1, the unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

23a75582d574.name: D-scythe
23a75582d574.plain: Blast. An unmodified 6 to wound with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as its usual damage.

2453ada569fb.name: Expert Lancers
2453ada569fb.plain: In the Fight phase, whenever a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to its hit roll if this unit made a charge move this turn and includes a Shining Spear Exarch.

24b0dcd220d0.name: Spirit Stones
24b0dcd220d0.plain: When working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat this model as having twice as many wounds remaining as it really has.

24bd3db79d38.name: Phase Crystal
24bd3db79d38.plain: Amallyn Shadowguide gets a 4+ invulnerable save and can move over models and terrain as though they weren't there.

2600304e68b4.name: Surprise Assault
2600304e68b4.plain: If this unit was set up preparing a sudden assault and includes a Warp Spider Exarch, then when it is first set up on the battlefield, until the end of that turn, whenever one of its models is chosen to shoot, that model gets 1 extra attack with each death spinner it has.

26d914c169fc.name: Wailing Doom (shooting)
26d914c169fc.plain: For each hit scored by an attack with this weapon, draw a straight line between the nearest point of the bearer's base (or hull) and the nearest point of the closest model in the target unit. Then make one wound roll against the target unit and one against every other unit the line crosses.

2792fd3ef896.name: Explodes (Revenant Titan)
2792fd3ef896.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 5+, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

27b11e9b3f83.name: Isirmathil
27b11e9b3f83.plain: For every attack made with this weapon, you make 2 hit rolls rather than 1.

2a1658e11aca.name: Explodes (Vyper)
2a1658e11aca.plain: When a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

2a9d66eabf2a.name: Witch Strike (Blessing)
2a9d66eabf2a.plain: If this power is manifested, choose one model in this PSYKER unit (if it is an ANHRATHE unit, you must choose its Way Seeker model). Until your next Psychic phase begins, whenever the chosen model makes a melee attack that successfully wounds the target, the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

2aacc262b721.name: 4.1 Protect (Blessing)
2aacc262b721.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, its models' Save characteristic is improved by 1, but not better than 2+.

2b227d8fe3b4.name: Spirit Mark (Aura)
2b227d8fe3b4.plain: Aura: while one of your <CRAFTWORLD> SPIRIT HOST CORE units is within 6" of this model, you re-roll a wound roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit attacks.

2ce8a3594f36.name: Terror's Lament
2ce8a3594f36.plain: Enemy units targeted by a charge from the bearer's unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend against that charge. Any enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer has 1 subtracted from its models' Attacks characteristic, and is not eligible to fight this phase until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

2d70a6890b7c.name: Runes of the Farseer
2d70a6890b7c.plain: At the start of each battle round, once you have made the Strands of Fate roll but before you choose which dice to keep, you can re-roll one of those dice for every FARSEER model in your army that is on the battlefield but not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

2d930e7f9b62.name: Focused Fire
2d930e7f9b62.plain: Whenever this unit's Dark Reaper Exarch makes a ranged attack, add 1 to its wound roll.

2df6435aed86.name: Malicious Frenzy
2df6435aed86.plain: When a TWILIGHT unit from your army is chosen to fight: until those attacks are resolved, whenever a model in that unit attacks, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

2ee46f0a5257.name: D-impaler
2ee46f0a5257.plain: Blast. Whenever an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ makes the target suffer D3 mortal wounds on top of any normal damage.

313efd03471e.name: Burning Heat
313efd03471e.plain: While this unit includes a Fire Dragon Exarch model, whenever a model in it makes a ranged attack against a unit within 9" and scores a hit, that attack wounds the target automatically.

345648ae310d.name: The Storm of Silence (Aura)
345648ae310d.plain: Aura: while one of your HOWLING BANSHEES units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

361824a74af3.name: Skyhunters
361824a74af3.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll when this model shoots at a unit that can FLY, and you may re-roll the wound roll for that attack.

36b1ecaa1ba4.name: Psyker (Spiritseer)
36b1ecaa1ba4.plain: 1 power, taken from either Runes of Battle or Runes of Fortune.

379dfdca0c29.name: Heartstrike
379dfdca0c29.plain: Whenever this unit's Shining Spear Exarch makes a melee attack, an unmodified wound roll of 5+ also deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage.

37af03549b56.name: War Dancers
37af03549b56.plain: At the end of the Fight phase, pick one HARLEQUINS TROUPE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units; it can fight again. You can use this Stratagem only once per battle round.

39b38d1c5cbe.name: Capricious Reflections
39b38d1c5cbe.plain: During your opponent's Charge phase, as one of your LIGHT units is picked as a charge target: provided it isn't in Engagement Range of any enemy units, it may make a Normal Move of up to 6". For the rest of the phase it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. After that, your opponent may pick new targets for that charge.

3aa9a2683c43.name: Star Lance (melee)
3aa9a2683c43.plain: When the bearer has completed a charge move this turn, each of its attacks with this weapon gets a Strength characteristic of +5.

3c4c74b9ff45.name: Matchless Agility
3c4c74b9ff45.plain: During your Shooting phase, once you have rolled the D6 for how far one of your ASURYANI units goes with its Battle Focus move: re-roll that D6.

3e2ecd2eedf8.name: Whirling Death
3e2ecd2eedf8.plain: If this unit made a charge move this turn, add 1 to the wound roll whenever one of its models makes a melee attack.

3e64b659169f.name: Tempest of Blades
3e64b659169f.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, choose a WINDRIDER HOST FARSEER SKYRUNNER unit of yours. For the rest of that phase, friendly WINDRIDER HOST units within 6" of it improve the Armour Penetration of their shooting attacks by 1 (so AP-1 becomes AP-2, for example).

3e9a49a2694e.name: Phantasm
3e9a49a2694e.plain: When the first battle round starts, before the first turn: choose up to 3 of your ASURYANI, HARLEQUINS or YNNARI units (not TITANIC units) and redeploy them. When the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rules, you may move any of them into Strategic Reserves at no extra Command point cost, no matter how many units are already there. If both players have abilities that redeploy units, roll off, and the winner decides who redeploys first. This Stratagem can be used only once.

3f0fec31ce04.name: 2.2 Horrify (Malediction)
3f0fec31ce04.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, subtract 2 from that unit's Leadership characteristic, and if it is within Engagement Range of any of your units at the start of the Fight phase, it is not eligible to fight that phase until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

3f29209e576b.name: Mocking Laughter

3f589d80af68.name: Favoured of the Laughing God
3f589d80af68.plain: After you nominate a HARLEQUINS model (not a named character) as your WARLORD: it gets one extra Warlord Trait, which must come from the Harlequins Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly). You can use this Stratagem only once.

3f6330bd88e7.name: Spirit Shield
3f6330bd88e7.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, choose a WRAITH HOST WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit of yours no more than 6" from a friendly WRAITH HOST SPIRITSEER. Until your next turn begins, the unit has a 4+ invulnerable save, while the SPIRITSEER loses the 4+ invulnerable save that its Rune Armour grants.

3fa1c8ce83bb.name: Rune Armour
3fa1c8ce83bb.plain: This model gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

4056523c1471.name: Withering Volleys
4056523c1471.plain: During your Shooting phase, as one of your ALTANSAR units is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, its models' attacks with an Aeldari missile launcher or Reaper launcher get their Armour Penetration improved by 1. The cost is 2CP if the unit has the DARK REAPERS keyword, otherwise 1CP.

40cbc1703abc.name: Deadly Ambush
40cbc1703abc.plain: If this unit is wholly on or within an Area Terrain feature and has a Striking Scorpion Exarch in it, melee attacks made by its models get 1 added to the hit roll and have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

41254b8622f7.name: Inferno Lance
41254b8622f7.plain: Attacks with this weapon against a target within half range have a Damage characteristic of D6+2.

44de5eccbc37.name: Shade of Twilight
44de5eccbc37.plain: During deployment, you may put this model in the shadows instead of on the battlefield. If you do, it can arrive in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

46215c9587b3.name: Explodes (Cobra)
46215c9587b3.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 4+, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

465557bce815.name: Wraithseer
465557bce815.plain: Knows 1 psychic power from the Runes of Battle discipline.

468ae3bc506e.name: Stand Firm
468ae3bc506e.plain: This unit has Objective Secured. If it already had Objective Secured, each of its models counts as two models when working out which player controls an objective marker. Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of this unit's models.

46a6fd8f2790.name: Lightning Attacks
46a6fd8f2790.plain: Whenever this unit consolidates, if it includes a Shining Spear Exarch, it can move an extra 6".

478934e5cb97.name: Ally of Convenience
478934e5cb97.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, this unit can be part of a <CRAFTWORLD> or <KABAL> Detachment, and that Detachment's models still get their Detachment abilities. Also, having this unit in your army doesn't stop ASURYANI or DRUKHARI units in your army from using rules that need every model in your army to have the ASURYANI or DRUKHARI keyword.

494320b2a181.name: Wireweave Grenades

4bb5d32ec694.name: Ynnead Awakened (Aura)
4bb5d32ec694.plain: Aura: while one of your YNNARI CORE units is within 12" of this model, you can ignore some or all of the modifiers whenever that unit takes a Combat Attrition test.

4e08bddfc945.name: Mindshock Pod
4e08bddfc945.plain: The bearer has this ability: Mindshock Pod (Aura): enemy units within 12" of any model with a mindshock pod have their Leadership reduced by 2.

4ebe9f27bc8d.name: Rapid Redeployment
4ebe9f27bc8d.plain: While this unit includes a Swooping Hawks Exarch, it can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

4f8ce4888ed3.name: Discipline of the Black Guardians
4f8ce4888ed3.plain: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, as you pick an ULTHWÉ GUARDIANS unit to shoot or fight: for the rest of the phase, its models add 1 to the hit roll of each attack they make.

5033ec96f9c8.name: Cegorach’s Jest
5033ec96f9c8.plain: During your opponent's Movement phase, as an enemy unit in Engagement Range of one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units Falls Back: after it completes that move, choose one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units that was in Engagement Range of that enemy unit when the phase started. The chosen unit may either consolidate up to 6" or shoot as though it were your Shooting phase; if it shoots, its only allowed target is that enemy unit. Consolidating makes this Stratagem cost 2CP; otherwise its cost is 1CP.

5057c83876df.name: D-cannon
5057c83876df.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see. Whenever an attack is made with it, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage.

51a54e43e8ea.name: Mandiblasters
51a54e43e8ea.plain: Whenever the bearer attacks a non-VEHICLE unit in melee, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

521fa28e9be9.name: Sonic Lance
521fa28e9be9.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically. A wound roll of 2+ always succeeds, unless the target is a VEHICLE or MONSTER, in which case a wound roll of 4+ always succeeds.

5224f934d8bb.name: Spectre Holo-field
5224f934d8bb.plain: Hit rolls made by enemy units against a unit with this ability have 1 subtracted from them.

524f725debbe.name: Ghostwalk (Blessing)
524f725debbe.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 12" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 2 to that unit's charge rolls.

53ccb16f41ee.name: Searsong - Beam
53ccb16f41ee.plain: For each hit scored by an attack with this weapon, draw a straight line between the nearest point of the bearer's base (or hull) and the nearest point of the closest model in the target unit. Then make one wound roll against the target unit and one against every other unit the line crosses.

546eb7171ec3.name: 1. Gaze of Ynnead
546eb7171ec3.plain: If this power is manifested, roll one D6 for an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER; if that unit's Starting Strength was 1, subtract 2 from the roll. Result of 1 or less: 1 mortal wound. Result of 2-5: D3 mortal wounds. Result of 6: D6 mortal wounds. The mortal wounds are inflicted on that enemy unit.

5504c0c84574.name: Starhawk Missile
5504c0c84574.plain: During your Shooting phase, as one of your ASURYANI models aims an Aeldari missile launcher at an AIRCRAFT unit: that model gets just one attack with that weapon this phase, but the attack adds 1 to its hit roll. On a hit, the target suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

55059374734e.name: The Avatar Resurgent
55059374734e.plain: During the Fight phase, if one of your AVATAR OF KHAINE models is destroyed before being picked to fight this phase: leave it on the battlefield. Its Attacks characteristic goes up by 2, and it may fight after the attacking model's unit has made all its attacks. Remove it once its own attacks have been resolved.

553d7de80504.name: Champion of the Aeldari
553d7de80504.plain: Before the battle, as you muster your army, provided your WARLORD has one of the keywords ASURYANI or HARLEQUINS: choose one ASURYANI CHARACTER or HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model of yours and give it one Warlord Trait. It counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if generating randomly), and you can't use this Stratagem to hand a model 2 Warlord Traits. It can be used only once, except twice in a Strike Force battle or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

56f70a0d9690.name: Harvester of Souls (Aura)
56f70a0d9690.plain: Aura: while one of your DARK REAPERS units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

58e8397eeae9.name: Reavers of the Void
58e8397eeae9.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically and counts as an unmodified wound roll of 6.

5a3a58ead4c5.name: Ride the Wind
5a3a58ead4c5.plain: When this unit Advances, skip the Advance roll. Instead, its models add 6" to their Move characteristic until the phase ends.

5ab5eb52bbc9.name: Scorpion Chainsword
5ab5eb52bbc9.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon.

5bf85aab7764.name: Piercing Strikes
5bf85aab7764.plain: Melee attacks made by this unit's Howling Banshee Exarch model get 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

5ceeba7120c8.name: Psychic Powers (Warlocks)
5ceeba7120c8.plain: Knows 1 psychic power from the Runes of Battle discipline.

5db9561ef7a4.name: Pathfinder Ambush
5db9561ef7a4.plain:
During the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, once an enemy unit has been set up on the battlefield: choose an ALAITOC RANGERS unit of yours that is on the battlefield or waiting in Strategic Reserves.
• If the RANGERS unit is still in Strategic Reserves, place it anywhere on the battlefield no more than 18" from that enemy unit and more than 9" from every enemy model.
• When the phase ends, that RANGERS unit may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase; for the rest of that phase, its only allowed target is the enemy unit that just arrived (and only if that unit is an eligible target).

5e2f37f6d133.name: Asu-var, the Sword of Silent Screams
5e2f37f6d133.plain: For attacks with this weapon, a wound roll of 4+ means no invulnerable saving throws can be made against that attack.

5e5a528395e5.name: Hover Jet
5e5a528395e5.plain: During your Command phase you may have this model hover. If you do, until your next Command phase begins it has a Move characteristic of 20" and doesn't have the Airborne, Hard To Hit or Wings of Khaine abilities.

5eb17ca8976a.name: Staff of Ulthamar & Witchblade
5eb17ca8976a.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, any unmodified wound roll of 2+ always counts as a success.

60c799e95930.name: Fusion Gun [Legends]
60c799e95930.plain: When the target is within half this weapon's range, roll two dice for its damage and throw away the lower result.

61c0b545d733.name: Lightning Fast Reactions
61c0b545d733.plain: During your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, as one of your ASURYANI, HARLEQUINS or YNNARI units (not MONSTER units) is picked as the target of an attack: for the rest of the phase, attacks against that unit subtract 1 from their hit rolls.

62830c6c07fa.name: 1.1 Conceal (Blessing)
62830c6c07fa.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, that unit gets the benefit of Light Cover.

628f9f9a3f4f.name: Way of the Blade (Aura)
628f9f9a3f4f.plain: Aura: while one of your YNNARI CORE units is within 6" of this model, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit attacks.

6293fa9330c6.name: Scattershield
6293fa9330c6.plain: A model that has a scattershield gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

630842f7b2f9.name: Doom (Malediction)
630842f7b2f9.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, whenever a <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER unit in your army attacks that enemy unit, you can re-roll the wound roll. If the Psychic test result was 10 or more, the enemy unit you pick can be within 24" of this PSYKER instead.

633ad2c34db4.name: Unstoppable Revenant
633ad2c34db4.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move horizontally across other models as if they weren't there, except MONSTER and VEHICLE models.

63e0518e8515.name: Seer Council
63e0518e8515.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one FARSEER model from your army and one WARLOCKS unit from your army with 2 or more models. While that FARSEER is within 6" of that WARLOCKS unit, add 1 to its Psychic tests. While that FARSEER is within 3" of that WARLOCKS unit, it can use the Look Out, Sir rule even if the unit has fewer than 3 models. You can use this Stratagem only once.

64ed6fa4f21e.name: Faolchú
64ed6fa4f21e.plain: Light Cover gives no benefit against ranged attacks made by models in the bearer's unit.

65748fff7f3f.name: Fire and Fade
65748fff7f3f.plain: In your Shooting phase, after an ASURYANI, HARLEQUINS or YNNARI unit from your army (not an AIRCRAFT unit) has made its attacks: it can immediately make a Normal Move of up to 7". Unless it is a HARLEQUINS unit, it can't embark within a TRANSPORT model at the end of that move. Until the end of the turn, it isn't eligible to declare a charge. A unit with the Battle Focus ability can't make a Battle Focus move in a turn it was picked for this Stratagem.

65e652bab32e.name: Explodes (Vampire)
65e652bab32e.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

6602e99682f1.name: Blazing Fury
6602e99682f1.plain: While this unit includes a Fire Dragon Exarch model, the ranged weapons its models are equipped with get 4" added to their Range characteristic.

6757a3413c26.name: Titanic Stride
6757a3413c26.plain: For each attack made with this weapon, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1.

6829f1d71ca9.name: Forewarned
6829f1d71ca9.plain: Once the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase ends, choose a <CRAFTWORLD> unit of yours within 12" of a friendly <CRAFTWORLD> FARSEER model. It may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase, but its models may only shoot at a single eligible enemy unit that arrived as Reinforcements this turn and is no more than 18" from their unit.

693a455fc401.name: Unquenchable Resolve
693a455fc401.plain: As long as this model has lost any wounds, add 1 to its Strength characteristic and its Attacks characteristic.

695b631b9c7c.name: Inevitable Death
695b631b9c7c.plain: During deployment, you can keep this model in waiting rather than setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, you can bring it in when another unit is destroyed: before that unit's last model is removed, set this model up within 1" of that last model. While this model is on the battlefield, you can instead do this: when another unit is destroyed, before that unit's last model is removed, take this model off the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that last model. However it is set up by this ability, it must not be placed within Engagement Range of any enemy models, and it can't declare a charge or perform a Heroic Intervention for the rest of that turn.

6ada0fced8d6.name: Creature Handler
6ada0fced8d6.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and a Detachment has any DRUKHARI BEASTS units in it, one BEASTMASTER unit can be added to that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot.

6b64bdff8a46.name: Explodes (Hover Tank)
6b64bdff8a46.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

6b71afccdf28.name: Explosion of Soul Energy
6b71afccdf28.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before you take it off the table. If you roll a 6, it explodes: 1 mortal wound is inflicted on each unit within 3".

6bf61c178593.name: Webway Strike
6bf61c178593.plain:
Before the battle, at the point where reserves and transports are declared (or during deployment, if your mission skips that step): for 1CP, you may place one of your YNNARI BIKER, YNNARI INFANTRY, HARLEQUINS BIKER, HARLEQUINS INFANTRY, ASURYANI BIKER or ASURYANI INFANTRY units in the webway instead of on the battlefield; for 3CP, you may place two such units there instead.

During the Reinforcements step of any of your Movement phases, units in the webway can arrive: set them up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model. This Stratagem can be used only once.

6c137a208884.name: Hard to Hit
6c137a208884.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every ranged attack made against this model.

6c411c17ff3a.name: Serpent Shield
6c411c17ff3a.plain: Any unit that includes a model equipped with a serpent shield gets these benefits: its models have a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks; and for ranged attacks made against it, an unmodified wound roll of 1-2 always fails, regardless of any abilities of the attacking weapon or model.

6c54370c9b59.name: Artillery and Crew
6c54370c9b59.plain: For all rules purposes, each Support Weapon and its crew are one model, and crew models must stay within 1" of their Support Weapon model. So the crew can't be targeted or attacked on their own, and you measure all ranges and visibility to and from the Support Weapon model. This unit can't Advance, is never allowed to declare a charge or perform a Heroic Intervention, and doesn't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

6c83753d6299.name: Beastmaster (Aura)
6c83753d6299.plain: Aura: while one of your DRUKHARI BEAST units is within 6" of this model, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit attacks, and that unit's models can use this model's Leadership characteristic in place of their own.

6c8a8db60989.name: 3. Word of the Phoenix
6c8a8db60989.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your YNNARI INFANTRY units (not a WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit) within 6" of this PSYKER. Return one of its destroyed models to it with full wounds, or D3 of its destroyed models if the unit has the Troops Battlefield Role. A returned model may only be set up within Engagement Range of an enemy unit if that enemy unit is already within Engagement Range of the unit it is joining.

6f8845a3f1b0.name: Graceful Avoidance
6f8845a3f1b0.plain: While this unit includes a Howling Banshee Exarch model, its models have a 4+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

703c4107c7b9.name: D-bombard
703c4107c7b9.plain: Blast. Whenever an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ makes the target suffer 3 mortal wounds on top of any normal damage.

706b5e3f55b1.name: Nimble Escape
706b5e3f55b1.plain: During the Fight phase, once one of your WINDRIDER HOST units has fought: it may immediately move (and Advance) as though it were your Movement phase. If there are enemy units within 1" of it, it may Fall Back instead.

707fdc4a45aa.name: Fusion Charges
707fdc4a45aa.plain: During the Fight phase, as one of your FIRE DRAGONS units is picked to fight: choose a single model in it. That model may make only one attack this phase, which has to target an enemy VEHICLE unit. If the attack hits, the VEHICLE unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

70c9cef09369.name: Voidbringer
70c9cef09369.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon. For attacks with this weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 4+ also deals D3 mortal wounds to the target, on top of any other damage.

713a109c10af.name: The Shining Blade
713a109c10af.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon scores 1 extra hit.

72a7af9ff42e.name: Star Engines
72a7af9ff42e.plain: This model's Move characteristic is increased by 3".

7359f4f15145.name: Lodestar Helm
7359f4f15145.plain: This unit is never subject to Perils of the Warp.

736498e16c64.name: Dramatic Entrance
736498e16c64.plain: In the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase, choose one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units. For the rest of the phase, it is eligible to perform a Heroic Intervention, and the distance it needs to be from an enemy unit to do so becomes 6" horizontally and 5" vertically, rather than 3" horizontally and 5" vertically. When it performs a Heroic Intervention, each of its models can move up to 6". Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

740bb3d63b9e.name: Guide (Blessing)
740bb3d63b9e.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, you can re-roll the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes an attack. If the Psychic test result was 10 or more, you can pick such a unit within 24" of this PSYKER instead.

74a35e3d25b7.name: Assured Destruction
74a35e3d25b7.plain: Whenever this model makes a ranged attack against a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, you re-roll a wound roll of 1.

7548d3a81bef.name: Psyker (Farseer)
7548d3a81bef.plain: 2 powers, chosen from Runes of Fortune, Runes of Fate, or a mix of both.

75d8a09c5841.name: Explodes (Wraithknight)
75d8a09c5841.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

75ec6119583d.name: Will of Asuryan (Blessing)
75ec6119583d.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins: that unit has Objective Secured; it automatically passes any Morale test taken for it; and if it is performing an action, it can still shoot with ranged weapons without the action failing. If the Psychic test result was 8 or more, you can pick such a unit within 24" of this PSYKER instead.

7785f562e051.name: Sonic Destruction
7785f562e051.plain: In your Shooting phase, if an enemy unit (other than a unit that can FLY) is targeted by 2 or more of the Vibro Cannons carried by models in this unit, then until the end of the phase, Vibro Cannon attacks against that enemy unit hit automatically. If such an enemy unit is targeted by 3 or more of those Vibro Cannons, then until the end of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of Vibro Cannon attacks against it.

79f6a76cae35.name: Cloudbreaker
79f6a76cae35.plain: During deployment, you may place this unit in an orbital transport rather than on the battlefield. It can then arrive in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

7a5bdb1c9d8d.name: Swirling Energies
7a5bdb1c9d8d.plain: In your Shooting phase, each time you choose this model to shoot, it can target every eligible enemy unit with its swirling soul energy and resolve attacks against all of them. When it fires Overwatch, this weapon's attacks are only resolved against the charging unit.

7a72d377a383.name: Haywire Charges
7a72d377a383.plain: During your Shooting phase, as one of your HARLEQUINS HAYWIRE GRENADE units is picked to shoot: choose a single model in it. That model may make only one attack this phase, which has to target an enemy VEHICLE unit within 6" of it. If the attack hits, the VEHICLE unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

7a73af270edb.name: Wraithshield
7a73af270edb.plain: This model gets a 5+ invulnerable save.

7afd3f15d26c.name: 6.1 Empower (Blessing)
7afd3f15d26c.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 1 to the wound roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

7b50ca00bdaf.name: Warriors of the Raging Winds
7b50ca00bdaf.plain: At the start of your Charge phase, choose a SAIM-HANN BIKER unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, that unit may declare a charge even though it Advanced this turn.

7eff9b2fff01.name: Avatar of the Bloody-Handed God
7eff9b2fff01.plain: You can never give this model a Relic or a Warlord Trait.

7f360ff56338.name: Paragon Sabre
7f360ff56338.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon. You can re-roll the hit roll and the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.

7f90ca51e98d.name: Lightning Assault
7f90ca51e98d.plain: Whenever a ranged attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from its hit roll.

7fb666121fa0.name: Armour of Last Runes
7fb666121fa0.plain: This model gets a 4+ invulnerable save. When an attack is made against it, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails, no matter what abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

800c4a44f7f2.name: D-flail (Blast)
800c4a44f7f2.plain: Blast. This profile can target units the bearer can't see.

81b95add804d.name: Wraith Host
81b95add804d.plain: As you choose your army, select one Craftworlds Detachment in it to be a Wraith Host Specialist Detachment. The SPIRITSEERS and WRAITH CONSTRUCTS in it gain the WRAITH HOST keyword.

823ef2365f53.name: Hunter Unseen
823ef2365f53.plain: While this model is benefiting from cover, a ranged attack can only target it if the attacking model is within 12".

8281012b54d4.name: Battle Focus
8281012b54d4.plain: If Amallyn Shadowguide moves or Advances in her Movement phase, weapons (other than Heavy weapons) are fired as though she had stayed stationary.

835193a453e8.name: Shredding Fire
835193a453e8.plain: While this unit includes a Dire Avenger Exarch model, whenever one of its models makes a ranged attack with a shuriken weapon, the Shuriken ability triggers on an unmodified wound roll of 5+ for that attack rather than 6.

84e5b892b2c6.name: Explodes (Phantom)
84e5b892b2c6.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 5+, it explodes: every unit within 3D6" takes 2D6 mortal wounds.

8637a7e31971.name: Executioner (Witchfire)
8637a7e31971.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER, but not a CHARACTER unit with a Wounds characteristic of 9 or less. It suffers D3 mortal wounds, and if any of its models are destroyed by them, it then suffers D3 more mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result was 10 or more, the enemy unit you pick (still not a CHARACTER unit with 9 or fewer Wounds) can be within 24" of this PSYKER instead.

868650b79f2b.name: Vilith-zhar, the Sword of Souls - Piercing Strike
868650b79f2b.plain: Invulnerable saving throws can't be made against attacks made with this profile.

87e1176bf8b2.name: War Engine
87e1176bf8b2.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move across other models (except TITANIC models) as if they weren't there; while doing so it can move within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

8806701c95a4.name: Target Acquisition
8806701c95a4.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, choose an enemy unit no more than 12" from this unit. For the rest of that phase, when an OUTCASTS unit from your army fires a Ranger Long Rifle or Voidbringer at the chosen unit, the chosen unit gets no cover benefits against those attacks.

8938a716a575.name: Laser Lance (melee)
8938a716a575.plain: Attacks with this weapon get Strength +3 in any turn in which the bearer made a charge move.

89581cbbc27a.name: Sustained Assault
89581cbbc27a.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a melee attack by a model in this unit scores 1 extra hit. Attacks that this ability generates can't gain the benefit of that model's mandiblasters.

8a4fd614e681.name: Fire and Reposition
8a4fd614e681.plain: If one of your OUTCASTS units is making a Battle Focus move and any of its models want to cross any part of an Area Terrain feature: don't subtract 3"; the unit may move the whole distance rolled.

8ad58f4c30e4.name: Wireweave Net
8ad58f4c30e4.plain: Once per battle, when the bearer's unit is picked as the target of a charge, you may trigger the wireweave net. Roll one D6; on a 2+, D3 mortal wounds are inflicted on the charging unit, and for the rest of the phase, any unit declaring a charge against the bearer's unit has 2 subtracted from its charge rolls.

8ae47dad4c22.name: Treasures of the Aeldari
8ae47dad4c22.plain: Before the battle, as you muster your army, provided your WARLORD has one of the keywords ASURYANI or HARLEQUINS: a HARLEQUINS WARLORD lets you choose one HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model of yours, and an ASURYANI WARLORD lets you choose one ASURYANI CHARACTER model of yours. The chosen CHARACTER model may receive one Treasures of the Aeldari Relic (it must be one it is allowed). Every Relic in your army must be different, and you can't use this Stratagem to hand a model 2 Relics. It can be used only once, except twice in a Strike Force battle or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

8b2629fca759.name: Neuro Disruptor
8b2629fca759.plain: Unless the target is a VEHICLE unit, every hit scored by this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on it and ends the attack sequence.

8b55ad921fd6.name: First of the Phoenix Lords
8b55ad921fd6.plain: This model gets a 3+ invulnerable save.

8c782fe57acd.name: Forceshield
8c782fe57acd.plain: The bearer gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

8d15d8b4430d.name: Appear Unbidden
8d15d8b4430d.plain: During deployment, you can place Amallyn Shadowguide in the webway, walking its winding paths, rather than on the battlefield. At the end of a Movement phase of yours, this unit can emerge: place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

8d8e6bffa4f4.name: Inexhaustible Hatred
8d8e6bffa4f4.plain: During the Fight phase, as one of your ALTANSAR units is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, its models add 1 to the wound roll for melee attacks against a DAEMON unit (excluding VEHICLE and MONSTER units).

8dfe48480f60.name: Ranger Long Rifle
8dfe48480f60.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon. For attacks with this weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound, on top of the normal damage.

8e087201409f.name: Psyker (Eldrad)
8e087201409f.plain: 3 powers, chosen from Runes of Fortune, Runes of Fate, or a mix of both.

91fcb76471be.name: Kiss of Death
91fcb76471be.plain: During the Fight phase, as a HARLEQUIN'S KISS unit is picked to fight: until that fight is resolved, each unmodified wound roll of 6 for its models' melee attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as the usual damage. No unit can suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this Stratagem. The same unit can't be picked for both this Stratagem and the Oblivion's Caress Stratagem in the same phase.

93750639c47d.name: Shade Runner Assault
93750639c47d.plain: If this unit has a Shade Runner model in it, then every time it finishes a charge move you can choose one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6 for that unit: a 6 inflicts 2 mortal wounds on it, while a 2-5 inflicts 1 mortal wound.

94fe6e7c6903.name: Focus Will (Blessing)
94fe6e7c6903.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI PSYKER units within 24" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 2 to any Psychic test or Deny the Witch test taken for that unit.

952703774a9e.name: Path of the Shaper
952703774a9e.plain: In your Psychic phase, instead of trying to manifest any psychic powers, this model can reknit wraithbone. If it does, pick one <CRAFTWORLD> VEHICLE or <CRAFTWORLD> WRAITH CONSTRUCT model within 3"; D3 lost wounds are restored to that model. No model can be healed by this ability more than once per turn.

952faf9f40d0.name: Cameleoline Cloak
952faf9f40d0.plain: Your opponent must subtract 1 from hit rolls for ranged weapons targeting Amallyn Shadowguide. If a ranged attack is allocated to this model while it is benefiting from cover, armour saving throws made against that attack get a further 1 added.

95c67fda8019.name: Spider's Lair
95c67fda8019.plain: Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, you may declare a terrain feature webbed if this unit is wholly within that Area Terrain feature and includes a Warp Spider Exarch. Until your next turn starts, enemy units treat the webbed feature as having the Difficult Ground terrain trait, and whenever an enemy unit finishes any move inside it (other than a pile-in or consolidation move), roll one D6: on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

96dca61afc56.name: Mind War (Witchfire)
96dca61afc56.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy CHARACTER model within 18" of this PSYKER. Then you roll one D6 and add this PSYKER's Leadership to it, and your opponent rolls one D6 and adds the enemy CHARACTER model's Leadership. If your total beats theirs, that CHARACTER model suffers mortal wounds equal to the difference. With a Psychic test result of 10 or more, you may roll 2D3 in place of your single D6 when adding to this PSYKER's Leadership.

989fd0c7a5a5.name: Path of Command (Aura)
989fd0c7a5a5.plain: Aura: while one of your <CRAFTWORLD> CORE units is within 6" of this model, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit attacks.

992d97ef7302.name: Path of Command (Aura)
992d97ef7302.plain: Aura: while one of your IYANDEN CORE or ANHRATHE INFANTRY units is within 6" of this model, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit attacks.

9ba1cd1703c1.name: Crewed Platform (Defenders)
9ba1cd1703c1.plain: If the last Guardian Defender model in this unit is destroyed, any Heavy Weapon Platform models still in the unit are destroyed too. Leave Heavy Weapon Platform models out when working out the unit's Starting Strength or whether it is below Half-strength, and ignore their destruction for Morale tests.

9c5a41e8ac4d.name: The Tears of Isha
9c5a41e8ac4d.plain: In your Command phase, pick one <CRAFTWORLD> WRAITH CONSTRUCT model from your army. It regains up to D3 lost wounds, or 3 lost wounds instead if it is within 6" of a friendly <CRAFTWORLD> SPIRITSEER model. This Stratagem costs 2CP if you pick a TITANIC model, and 1CP otherwise.

9cdfd4bd12ed.name: 5. Shield of Ynnead
9cdfd4bd12ed.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your YNNARI units (not a TITANIC unit) within 12" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

9d274a708d98.name: Wraithcannon
9d274a708d98.plain: For attacks with this weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

9d581d0cfdae.name: Heavy Wraithcannon
9d581d0cfdae.plain: Blast. An unmodified 6 to wound with this weapon inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the target as well as its usual damage.

9dde999173a6.name: Defiant to the Last
9dde999173a6.plain: At the start of your Command phase, choose one of your ALTANSAR units. That unit has the Objective Secured ability until your next Command phase begins.

9e0e638c1f8b.name: Supersonic
9e0e638c1f8b.plain: When this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, start by pivoting it in place up to 90 degrees (this pivot doesn't add to the distance it moves), then move it straight ahead. It can't pivot again after that first pivot.

9e5d643810a2.name: Smite
9e5d643810a2.plain: Warp charge: 5. When manifested, the closest enemy unit that is visible and within 18" of the psyker takes D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result exceeded 10, it takes D6 mortal wounds instead.

waive.181: page number reference ("pg 181"), which the style guide says to leave out

9ef22e7d8482.name: Titanic
9ef22e7d8482.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

9f360128380e.name: Herald of Ynnead
9f360128380e.plain: Roll one D6 each time another AELDARI model is destroyed within 6" of this model. On a 4+, 1 lost wound is restored to this model; in addition, if the destroyed AELDARI model was a PSYKER, you can pick one Revenant discipline psychic power, which this model then knows for the rest of the battle alongside any others it knows.

a038df62b66b.name: Heroes’ Path

a03a8d75bb3d.name: Fateful Divergence (Blessing)
a03a8d75bb3d.plain: When this power is manifested, you receive 1 Command Point.

a14b24630176.name: Superlative Strategist
a14b24630176.plain: As long as at least one unit in your army with this ability is on the battlefield (or inside a TRANSPORT model that is on the battlefield), you may use the Command Re-roll Stratagem up to twice per phase rather than just once.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a page cross-reference, which the style guide says to leave out

a3c122c6649d.name: Acrobatic
a3c122c6649d.plain: This unit can declare a charge even in a turn in which it Advanced. Attacks made against this unit have 1 subtracted from their hit roll.

a447a289fd00.name: Shield Discharge
a447a289fd00.plain:
At the start of your Charge phase, choose one of your models that has a serpent shield or Wave Serpent shield, and choose an enemy unit within 12" of it. Until the turn ends:
• the enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend;
• melee attacks by models in the enemy unit subtract 1 from their hit rolls.
Once this Stratagem has been used, the chosen model no longer counts as having a serpent shield or Wave Serpent shield.

a472ce3250e6.name: Bringer of Death
a472ce3250e6.plain: If this unit's Dark Reaper Exarch has a Reaper Launcher or Shuriken Cannon, it gets 1 extra attack with that weapon whenever it is chosen to shoot. If the Exarch has an Aeldari Missile Launcher or Tempest Launcher, the target of each ranged attack it makes gets no benefit from cover against that attack.

a5da2a1cbaa1.name: Khaine Awakened (Aura)
a5da2a1cbaa1.plain: Aura: while one of your ASURYANI CORE units is within 12" of this model, you can ignore some or all of the modifiers whenever that unit takes a Combat Attrition test.

a63348c72ed3.name: Psyker (Way Seeker)
a63348c72ed3.plain: This unit's Way Seeker model is the point from which you measure distances and draw line of sight whenever the unit tries to manifest a psychic power, Deny the Witch or perform a psychic action. Likewise, when an enemy unit's ability needs distances measured or line of sight drawn to PSYKER units, measure and draw them to this unit's Way Seeker model.

a892ec421601.name: Cry of the Wind (Aura)
a892ec421601.plain: Aura: while one of your SWOOPING HAWKS units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

a8e68ee4f26a.name: Linked Fire
a8e68ee4f26a.plain:
At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one FIRE PRISM model from your army, then pick one or two other friendly FIRE PRISM models that are within 12" of it and visible to it. Until the end of the phase, whenever the first FIRE PRISM model you picked shoots with the focused lance profile of its prism cannon:
• it gets 2 extra attacks with that weapon (using the focused lance profile) for each other FIRE PRISM model you picked;
• invulnerable saves can't be taken against any attacks it makes with that weapon.
Until the end of the phase, the other FIRE PRISM models you picked can't attack with their prism cannons.

a955fdd07783.name: Avatar of the Whispering God
a955fdd07783.plain: You can never give this model a Relic or Warlord Trait.

a96cc5417adc.name: Unstoppable Revenant (Wraithknight)
a96cc5417adc.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move horizontally across other models as if they weren't there, except MONSTER or VEHICLE models.

a99f860682f3.name: 5.1 Quicken (Blessing)
a99f860682f3.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. That unit may immediately move as if it were the Movement phase, making a Normal Move, an Advance or a Fall Back. A unit that moves this way can't shoot or declare a charge this turn.

aa2311240ad2.name: Scorpion's Sting
aa2311240ad2.plain: When this unit is chosen to fight, if it includes a Striking Scorpion Exarch, that Exarch's mandiblasters work differently until the fight is over: whenever the Exarch makes a melee attack against a unit that is not a VEHICLE, an unmodified wound roll of 5+ also deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of the normal damage.

ab4736f07935.name: The Phoenix Reborn
ab4736f07935.plain: When one of your PHOENIX LORD models is destroyed, you may skip any rules triggered by its destruction and instead roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 4+, put it back on the battlefield as near as possible to where it was destroyed, not within Engagement Range of any enemy model, with D3 wounds left. The same model can't be returned by this Stratagem more than once per battle.

ad0946498e09.name: Shadow of Death (Aura)
ad0946498e09.plain: Aura: enemy units within 6" of this unit get 1 taken off their models' Leadership characteristic.

ad264cb737ed.name: Chaneller Stones
ad264cb737ed.plain: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw fails for the bearer's unit, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

ad89f99021ee.name: Autarch Jump Generator
ad89f99021ee.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic becomes 12", and it gains the JUMP PACK keyword and the Warp Strike ability. Whenever this unit makes a Normal Move, a Battle Focus move, an Advance, a Fall Back or a Charge move, its models can pass through models and terrain features until that move is over, though no model may finish on top of another model or its base. A Battle Focus move by the bearer's unit can instead be up to 2D6". If two or more of the dice rolled for that distance come up 1, the bearer's unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

adbad51499e1.name: Whips of the Master
adbad51499e1.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one DRUKHARI BEAST unit in your army within 6" of this model. That BEAST unit can declare a charge this turn even if it Advanced.

ae1f1344f262.name: D-flail (Rift)
ae1f1344f262.plain: Attacks made with this profile hit the target automatically.

afcdaf4e70c8.name: Extend Wings
afcdaf4e70c8.plain: During your Command phase you may have this model extend its wings. If you do, until your next Command phase begins it has a Move characteristic of 20" and doesn't have the Wings of Khaine, Airborne, Hard to Hit or Agile Interceptor abilities.

aff39ee4743c.name: Warden of Yvraine
aff39ee4743c.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and a Detachment in it includes a YVRAINE model, this model can join that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot. While one of your YVRAINE models is within 3" of this model, that YVRAINE model can't be chosen as the target of ranged attacks.

b0169ff98561.name: Defenders
b0169ff98561.plain: Models in this unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 for ranged attacks made with shuriken weapons while the unit is within range of an objective marker.

b155f8ab879c.name: Biting Blade
b155f8ab879c.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon.

b1826115d9d8.name: Ranger Cloak
b1826115d9d8.plain: If a model in this unit has a ranged attack allocated to it while it is benefiting from cover, armour saving throws made against that attack get a further 1 added.

b206bf1516a3.name: Psyker (Way Seeker)
b206bf1516a3.plain: Smite, plus 1 power taken from either Runes of Fate or Runes of Fortune.

b2417928a45d.name: Swirling Soul Energy
b2417928a45d.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically.

b544e4670baf.name: Crewed Platform (Storm)
b544e4670baf.plain: If the last Storm Guardian model in this unit is destroyed, any Serpent's Scale Platform models still in the unit are destroyed too. Leave Serpent's Scale Platform models out when working out the unit's Starting Strength or whether it is below Half-strength, and ignore their destruction for Morale tests.

b55743dbae00.name: Howling Banshee Mask
b55743dbae00.plain: When you pick an enemy unit as a target of a charge by the bearer's unit, that enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend against the charge. If the bearer's unit made a charge move this turn, any enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer is not eligible to fight in this phase until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

b5f089039012.name: Burning Demise
b5f089039012.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before you take it off the table. If you roll a 6, it explodes: D3 mortal wounds are inflicted on each unit within D6".

b603e1aceb79.name: 4.2 Jinx (Malediction)
b603e1aceb79.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, its models' Save characteristic is worsened by 1, but not worse than 6+.

b6845c3e7c5e.name: Vectored Engines
b6845c3e7c5e.plain: Once per battle, during your Command phase, you may fire up this model's vectored engines. When you do, this model gains the Battle Focus ability until the turn ends.

waive.147: page number reference ("pg. 147") pointing to where Battle Focus is printed; the style guide forbids page references

b8aa7921200c.name: 2.1 Embolden (Blessing)
b8aa7921200c.plain: Pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 2 to that unit's Leadership characteristic, and if it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units at the start of the Fight phase, it can fight first that phase.

waive.<CRATWORLD> ASURYANI CORE: typo in the official text for <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE; the plain text uses the correctly spelled <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE keyword

b9591fd98d1b.name: Shade of Twilight
b9591fd98d1b.plain: During deployment, you may put this unit in the shadows instead of on the battlefield. If you do, it can arrive in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models.

b985d9b89949.name: A Deadly Embrace
b985d9b89949.plain: Once one of your HARLEQUIN'S EMBRACE units has made a charge move or a Heroic Intervention: choose an enemy unit (excluding VEHICLE or MONSTER units) in Engagement Range of it, and roll one D6 per model in the HARLEQUIN'S EMBRACE unit. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that enemy unit, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

ba44642b93ba.name: Hover Tank
ba44642b93ba.plain: Measure distances to and from this model's hull or its base, whichever is closer.

ba71365f7717.name: Defensive Stance
ba71365f7717.plain: In your Shooting phase, while this unit includes a Dire Avenger Exarch model, its models can make ranged attacks even though the unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, and even when other friendly units are within Engagement Range of those enemy units as well. Attacks made this way can only target enemy units that are within Engagement Range of this unit.

ba8fc5b8d06d.name: Strafing Assault
ba8fc5b8d06d.plain: Targets of this model's ranged attacks get no benefit from cover against those attacks.

bb0c0c88d207.name: Hand of Asuryan (Aura)
bb0c0c88d207.plain: Aura: while one of your DIRE AVENGERS units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

bbb6f5c9b004.name: 3.2 Drain (Malediction)
bbb6f5c9b004.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, subtract 1 from the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

bd258cc49df5.name: Firestorm Scatter Laser
bd258cc49df5.plain: Add 2 to the hit roll of attacks made with this weapon against an Aircraft unit.

bd4e68249b0e.name: Martial Citizenry
bd4e68249b0e.plain: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, as one of your GUARDIANS units is picked to shoot or fight: for the rest of the phase, its models re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

bd933adb0b3c.name: Eldritch Storm
bd933adb0b3c.plain:
In your Command phase, while one of your FARSEER models is on the battlefield: choose a point on the battlefield no more than 24" from a FARSEER model of yours and mark it with a marker. During your next Psychic phase, your FARSEER models within 24" of that marker can attempt the psychic action below.

Empower Storm (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 5): it may be attempted by any number of your FARSEER models that have visibility to the marker's centre.

When your next Shooting phase starts, each unit within 6" of the marker's centre gets one D6 roll; on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Remove the marker afterwards. This Stratagem can be used only once.

bdaac42ae1a0.name: Strands of Fate
bdaac42ae1a0.plain: This only applies if every unit in your army is an ASURYANI unit and all of them come from one craftworld, not counting PHOENIX LORD, ANHRATHE or UNALIGNED units. When each battle round begins, you can roll six D6 and keep some of them: you keep 2 in a Combat Patrol battle, 3 in an Incursion battle, 4 in a Strike Force battle or 5 in an Onslaught battle. Each kept result is tied to one kind of roll: 1 is an Advance roll, 2 a charge roll, 3 a Psychic test, 4 a hit roll, 5 a wound roll and 6 a saving throw. During that battle round, each kept die can be spent once: just before a unit with this ability makes a roll of the kind that die is tied to, you can spend it, and that roll (or one of its dice, if the roll uses several dice) is treated as an unmodified 6 instead of being rolled.

bea7e5799291.name: War Construct
bea7e5799291.plain: This unit's models may fire ranged weapons while their unit is in Engagement Range of enemy units, though a model doing so may only pick enemy units it is itself in Engagement Range of. When firing like this, they may pick such an enemy unit as a target even though other friendly units are also in Engagement Range of it.

bfacc8f86176.name: 4. Unbind Souls
bfacc8f86176.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Whenever a YNNARI model in your army makes a melee attack against that enemy unit, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

bfcc72d4a7e9.name: Bringer of the True Death
bfcc72d4a7e9.plain: Whenever this model attacks a NECRONS unit, add 1 to both the hit roll and the wound roll for that attack.

c07e8cf3a5c3.name: Torments of the Fiery Pit
c07e8cf3a5c3.plain: During the Fight phase, as one of your HARLEQUINS CHARACTER models (not SOLITAIRE models) that has lost any wounds is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, its Strength and Attacks characteristics are each increased by 1.

c14d44f912ef.name: Ghosthelm
c14d44f912ef.plain: This model is never subject to Perils of the Warp.

c336e752ef57.name: Explodes (Scorpion)
c336e752ef57.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 5+, it explodes: every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

c3b2e94bfdcc.name: Revenant Jet Pack
c3b2e94bfdcc.plain: When this model Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, add 18" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

c3c359cb119e.name: The Maugetar (shooting)
c3c359cb119e.plain: For attacks with this weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of the normal damage.

c449cce8dfd8.name: Agile Interceptor
c449cce8dfd8.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. Add 1 to the hit roll of each attack this model makes against an AIRCRAFT unit.

c518c4c0aa9e.name: The Silken Knife
c518c4c0aa9e.plain: At the start of the Charge phase, pick one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, whenever a DARK unit picks that enemy unit as a charge target, the enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend.

c51fb2ce539b.name: 6. Ancestors' Grace
c51fb2ce539b.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your YNNARI units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, add 1 to the wound roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

c62553a484a3.name: The Great Enemy
c62553a484a3.plain: During the Fight phase, as one of your ASURYANI, HARLEQUINS or YNNARI units is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, its models may re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll for melee attacks against a SLAANESH unit.

c6af7d040f22.name: Aspect Armour
c6af7d040f22.plain: This unit's models get a 5+ invulnerable save.

c8b531eb9f19.name: Murderous Spectacle
c8b531eb9f19.plain: During your Charge phase, as one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units makes a charge move: until the turn ends, increase the Damage characteristic of its models' melee weapons by 1 (up to a maximum of 3).

c8d837505db5.name: Stormblades
c8d837505db5.plain: Whenever this unit's models attack in melee, you re-roll a hit roll of 1 if the enemy unit they are attacking is within range of any objective markers.

c9c42b6ea89b.name: Bladestorm
c9c42b6ea89b.plain: In the Shooting phase, as you pick one of your ASURYANI or HARLEQUINS units to shoot: for the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 that its models make with shuriken weapons scores 1 extra hit.

c9e2db0b4283.name: Winged Evasion
c9e2db0b4283.plain: Whenever this unit is chosen as the target of a ranged attack, if it includes a Swooping Hawk Exarch, then until the end of the phase subtract 1 from the hit roll of every ranged attack made against this unit.

cb65ef808af0.name: Wings of Khaine
cb65ef808af0.plain: When this model Advances, don't roll a dice; add 20" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead. Whenever this model moves, first pivot it on the spot by up to 90° (the pivot doesn't count towards the distance moved), then move it straight forwards. After its move ends, you can pivot it up to another 90° in the same way.

cb8800a9aa1c.name: Wraithbone Form
cb8800a9aa1c.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to a model in this unit, reduce that attack's Damage by 1, but not below 1.

cd24aca22777.name: Guided Wraithsight
cd24aca22777.plain: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, choose an IYANDEN SPIRITSEER model of yours and a friendly IYANDEN SPIRIT HOST unit. For the rest of the phase, the SPIRIT HOST unit counts as being in range of the SPIRITSEER model's Spirit Mark ability.

cd491156628f.name: Web of Deceit
cd491156628f.plain: Once per battle, if this unit includes a Warp Spider Exarch, you can take it off the battlefield instead of making a Battle Focus move, then set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

waive.142: page number reference ("pg 142") pointing to the Battle Focus rule; the style guide forbids page references

cd6fa23bdf15.name: Psyker (Hemlock)
cd6fa23bdf15.plain:
When this model tries to manifest a psychic power from the Runes of Battle discipline, it can only choose that power's second effect.
Smite.

d1e2896bd971.name: Molten Form
d1e2896bd971.plain: This model gets a 4+ invulnerable save. Any attack allocated to this model has its Damage characteristic halved (round up).

d26a991b1d64.name: Reaper of Souls (Aura)
d26a991b1d64.plain: Aura: while one of your SHADOW SPECTRES units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

d27dd9a3e2d2.name: Windrider Host
d27dd9a3e2d2.plain: As you choose your army, select one Craftworld Detachment in it to be a Windrider Host Specialist Detachment. These units in that Detachment gain the WINDRIDER HOST keyword: WINDRIDERS, VYPERS, AUTARCH SKYRUNNERS, FARSEER SKYRUNNERS, WARLOCK SKYRUNNERS and WARLOCK SKYRUNNER CONCLAVES.

d34013ce4b1c.name: Airborne
d34013ce4b1c.plain: This model can't declare a charge, and only units that can FLY can choose it as a charge target. It can only fight if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Enemy units can make melee attacks against this model only if they can FLY.

d3f901399c56.name: Webway Rupture
d3f901399c56.plain: During deployment, you may place this model in the webway rather than on the battlefield. It can then arrive in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

d3fda1fc3275.name: Deathshroud Cannon (Focused)
d3fda1fc3275.plain: Blast. For attacks made with this profile, an unmodified wound roll of 5+ gives that attack an Armour Penetration characteristic of -4.

d46f5fb1dce6.name: Inevitable Fate
d46f5fb1dce6.plain: When a YNNARI unit from your army is chosen to shoot or fight: until the end of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll whenever a model in that unit attacks a unit that was below Half-strength at the moment the attacking model's unit was chosen to shoot or fight.

d4988928db04.name: Deathly Form
d4988928db04.plain: This model gets a 4+ invulnerable save. Any attack allocated to this model has its Damage characteristic halved (round up).

d50ba65c42a8.name: Prismatic Blur
d50ba65c42a8.plain: During the Movement phase, as one of your HARLEQUINS INFANTRY units Advances more than 8": its models have a 4+ invulnerable save until your next Command phase begins. (Updated version: the Arks of Omen dataslate of Jan 2023 made every Harlequins invulnerable save 1 worse, so the original 3+ became 4+.)

d6417f569df1.name: Explodes
d6417f569df1.plain: When a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

d65574d83a80.name: The Scorpion's Bite
d65574d83a80.plain: Whenever the bearer attacks a non-VEHICLE unit in melee, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 2 mortal wounds to the target, on top of the normal damage.

d6e9b8669a07.name: Grenade Pack
d6e9b8669a07.plain: During your Movement phase, once one of your SWOOPING HAWKS units has made a Normal Move or Advanced: choose an enemy unit that any of its models moved across this phase. Roll one D6 per model in that SWOOPING HAWKS unit, taking 1 off each roll if the chosen enemy unit has the CHARACTER keyword (excluding VEHICLE or MONSTER units). Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the chosen enemy unit, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

d714a2c4271d.name: Psychic Powers (Warlocks)
d714a2c4271d.plain: If this unit's Starting Strength is 3, it knows 1 extra power from the Runes of Battle discipline. While it has 3 models, it can try to manifest 1 extra psychic power in your Psychic phase.

d96c4a2aa201.name: Burning Lance (Aura)
d96c4a2aa201.plain: Aura: while one of your FIRE DRAGONS units is within 6" of this model, its models get 2 added to their Leadership characteristic, and that unit gains Objective Secured.

da057820b6ed.name: First of Ulthwe
da057820b6ed.plain: You can re-roll any Psychic test taken for this model.

dd721d771ea8.name: Virtuosos of the Webway
dd721d771ea8.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one HARLEQUINS unit from your army that isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy models. Take it off the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

dd90e7779cda.name: Sustained Assault (Karandras)
dd90e7779cda.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a melee attack by this model scores 1 extra hit. Attacks that this ability generates can't gain the benefit of this model's The Scorpion's Bite ability.

dd945aa3f6b3.name: Crushing Orb (Witchfire)
dd945aa3f6b3.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit that is visible to this PSYKER and within 18" of it, then roll three D6. Add 2 to each of those results if the enemy unit is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit or has 6 or more models in it. The enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for every result of 4+.

df8c5ddb042a.name: Tempest Launcher
df8c5ddb042a.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see.

dfa8565f27e6.name: Distortion Field
dfa8565f27e6.plain: Against ranged attacks, this model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

e004f8e75333.name: Combat Drugs
e004f8e75333.plain: This unit's drug depends on a D6 result. 1 (Adrenalight): when this unit fights in a turn in which it made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention, its models get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved. 2 (Grave Lotus): its models get 1 added to their Strength characteristic. 3 (Hypex): its models get 2" added to their Move characteristic. 4 (Painbringer): its models get 1 added to their Toughness characteristic. 5 (Serpentin): its models' Weapon Skill characteristic is improved by 1. 6 (Splintermind): its models' Ballistic Skill and Leadership are improved by 1.

e07aebcbaf2e.name: No Price Too Steep
e07aebcbaf2e.plain: During the Fight phase, if one of your HARLEQUINS CHARACTER models is destroyed before being picked to fight this phase: leave it on the battlefield; it may fight after the attacking model's unit has made all its attacks. If it is a SOLITAIRE model, or a CHAOS unit destroyed it, add 1 to its Attacks and Strength characteristics for the rest of the phase. Remove it once its own attacks have been resolved.

e1cd4856b56a.name: The Bloody-Handed (Aura)
e1cd4856b56a.plain: Aura: while one of your ASURYANI CORE units is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll that unit's charge rolls.

e2473958fab8.name: Avengers of Asuryan
e2473958fab8.plain: At the end of your Shooting phase, choose a DIRE AVENGERS unit of yours that is below its Starting Strength. That unit gets to shoot a second time.

e3152dcd5980.name: Battle Psykers
e3152dcd5980.plain: When one of your WARLOCKS units containing at least 4 models manifests a Runes of Battle power, both effects of that power can be applied instead of only one.
