e3b03a54ba29.name: Explodes (Hornet)
e3b03a54ba29.plain: If this model drops to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before it leaves the battlefield. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 3" takes a mortal wound.

e5b6258d0265.name: Swift Scouts
e5b6258d0265.plain: As the first battle round begins, this unit's models may each make a Normal Move, but none of them may finish it within 9" of an enemy model.

e6c925cf322f.name: Singing Spear (melee)
e6c925cf322f.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, any unmodified wound roll of 2+ always counts as a success.

e6e616df04c7.name: Unparalleled Mastery
e6e616df04c7.plain: At the start of your Psychic phase, choose a FARSEER, SHADOWSEER, YVRAINE or THE YNCARNE model of yours. This phase, that unit may attempt to manifest one more psychic power than normal.

e6e78610052f.name: Warlock Conclave
e6e78610052f.plain: If this unit's Starting Strength is 1, it has the CHARACTER keyword.

e71c5f72903e.name: Oblivion’s Caress
e71c5f72903e.plain: During the Fight phase, as a HARLEQUIN'S CARESS unit is picked to fight: until that fight is resolved, no invulnerable saving throws can be taken against its models' melee attacks. A unit can't be picked for both this and the Kiss of Death Stratagem during one phase.

e81f0473e9b0.name: Dragon's Bite
e81f0473e9b0.plain: When this unit's Fire Dragon Exarch model makes a ranged attack against a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit that was within half range when this unit was chosen to shoot: an attack with a Dragon Fusion Gun or Firepike gets 2 added to its Damage characteristic; an attack with a Dragon's Breath Flamer gets 1 added to its Damage characteristic, and you can re-roll its wound roll.

e844ec664c85.name: Crystal Targeting Matrix
e844ec664c85.plain: Whenever this model makes a ranged attack, you can ignore some or all modifiers to the hit roll.

e9ac404f34e6.name: Champion of Ynnead
e9ac404f34e6.plain: Roll one D6 each time another AELDARI model is destroyed within 6" of this model. On a 4+, 1 lost wound is restored to this model; in addition, if the destroyed AELDARI model was a CHARACTER, this model's Attacks characteristic goes up by 1 for the rest of the battle.

eb3c66d8ac42.name: Explodes (6+)
eb3c66d8ac42.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6+, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

ebcd254f463f.name: Cloudstrike
ebcd254f463f.plain: If this TRANSPORT model began the battle set up preparing a Sudden Assault, you can place it on the battlefield during the Reinforcement step of your first, second or third Movement phase, whatever the mission rules say. Once it is placed this way, units embarked in it may disembark right away, but they must be placed more than 9" from every enemy model.

ec317e6e514c.name: Wave Serpent Shield
ec317e6e514c.plain: While this model has a Wave Serpent Shield: it has a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks; and whenever a ranged attack is made against it, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 fails, no matter what abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

eccb7e390d3c.name: The Sword of Asur
eccb7e390d3c.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 6 deals D3 mortal wounds to the target on top of any other damage.

eccfd2780b0e.name: Swift Demise
eccfd2780b0e.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks with a twin shuriken catapult and the target is an enemy unit within range of any objective marker, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

ed50bed59445.name: Ancient Doom
ed50bed59445.plain: In a turn in which this unit charges, or is charged by, a SLAANESH unit, you can re-roll its failed hit rolls in the Fight phase. However, while this unit is within 3" of any SLAANESH units, you must add 1 to its Morale tests.

f29b2c85ba03.name: Fortune (Blessing)
f29b2c85ba03.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one of your <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CORE or <CRAFTWORLD> ASURYANI CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, roll one D6 whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound; on a 5+ it keeps that wound. If the Psychic test result was 10 or more, you can pick such a unit within 24" of this PSYKER instead.

f32959e249dc.name: 6.2 Enervate (Malediction)
f32959e249dc.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, subtract 1 from the wound roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

f4598e71573c.name: Explodes
f4598e71573c.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

f49bc58f02d1.name: Wrath of the Shrines
f49bc58f02d1.plain: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, as one of your BIEL-TAN ASPECT WARRIOR units is picked to shoot or fight: for the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 its models make scores 1 extra hit.

f7630720a55e.name: Explodes (Transport)
f7630720a55e.plain: When this TRANSPORT model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you take it off the table. On a 6, it explodes: every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

f836504f8a97.name: 5.2 Restrain (Malediction)
f836504f8a97.plain: Pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase begins, halve the Move characteristic of that unit's models, and that unit can't perform actions (if it is performing one right now, that action fails at once).

f8c15497817d.name: Thrice-layered Wards
f8c15497817d.plain: During your opponent's Psychic phase, as soon as one of your ALTANSAR units would suffer a mortal wound: for the rest of that phase, roll one D6 for each wound that a model in that unit would lose; on a 4+ the wound isn't lost.

fb768437004a.name: Guardian Fusion Gun
fb768437004a.plain: When the target is within half this weapon's range, the attack's Damage characteristic is D6+2.

fdc19cb58625.name: Psyker
fdc19cb58625.plain: In your Psychic phase this model can try to manifest two psychic powers, and in your opponent's Psychic phase it can try to deny two. It knows Smite plus two powers from the Revenant discipline.

fe16a2b9105b.name: Doom Incarnate
fe16a2b9105b.plain: In the Morale phase, each enemy model destroyed by an attack from this model counts as two models.

feccab8d005d.name: Impair Senses (Malediction)
feccab8d005d.plain: If this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit that is visible to this PSYKER and within 18" of it. Until your next Psychic phase begins, aura abilities of units in your opponent's army have no effect on that enemy unit.
